scripts.prebuild: sh -c 'mkdir -p public && if [ -f ../install.sh ]; then cp ../install.sh public/install.sh; elif [ ! -f public/install.sh ]; then echo "error: public/install.sh missing" >&2; exit 1; fi && if [ -d ../goodboy ]; then tar -czf public/goodboy.tar.gz -C .. goodboy; elif [ ! -f public/goodboy.tar.gz ]; then echo "error: public/goodboy.tar.gz missing" >&2; exit 1; fi'
